sections.text: Introduction

This document lists the 
 medium maintenance procedure P2 of vertical rotary regenerative air heater, 
 which must be, performed every 6 month base as indicated by M6 in the title 
 block.

The first draft initiated 
by eng. Adel Mahmoud Al-maadawi, reviewed by Maintenance director eng. Saad 
Mostafa, revised by eng. Samir Abdel-Gelil at EDEPCo., accepted by maintenance 
general director: Ali Mostafa Al-lithy and approved by Eng.: Mostafa Alam Head 
Sector of TALKHA steam power station 2 x 210 MW.

sections.text: Work to be Carried Out

Adjustment of rotor 
sealing
Basic sealing adjustment in cold state

During the preparation of the regenerative 
 air heater for the first starting and after excessive repairs, the sealing 
 should be adjusted in cold state according to table 1. This basic 
 adjustment screws the assumed clearance of the sealing elements for the hot 
 operation of the heaters. The sealing is adjusted in cold state according to 
 schematic sketches with the heater shut down and the drive secured 
 disconnected from the electrical network.

Adjustment of sector 
boards

The sector boards are adjusted in setting the 
clearances A,B,G and F according to table no. 1 and to schematic fig. no.1
Adjustment of axial boards

The axial boards are basically adjusted in 
setting . The clearances C and E according to table 1 and the 
schematic figure no.2.

Adjustment of peripheral 
sealing and sector board sealing

The peripheral 
sealing are accessible from the flue gas channels and air channels of 
regenerative air heater only . their clearances H and J/ table 1 
can be adjusted in partial bending the sealing sheets and checking them with a 
feeler gauge such adjustment may be done on a 
shut down heater. The same is true for the sector board sealing. For adjustment 
that sealing see the schematic figure.3 .

Adjustment of 
clearance in hot state

items:
When setting 
 the regenerative air heater into hot state you should cautiously its run and 
 function to prevent the sealing from damage or destroying and/or the rotor 
 from jamming due to thermal dilatation of its parts, which could cause a crash 
 of the drive or motor. Above all the motor ammeter and its loading should be 
 checked. For that purpose it is recommended to connect a precise and sensitive 
 checking ammeter easy to inspect from the service place. the basic current 
 consumption will be established during the cold run of the regenerative air 
 heater after adjusting the clearances to ref. table no. 1. The check of the basic 
 current consumption for the drive of the regeneration air heater under cold 
 run should be done twice a year at last namely, it could be partly changed due 
 to running in the plant and to other operating influences.

The clearances 
 of the sector and axial boards will be adjusted by means of control elements as late 
 as under full operation of the heater for the optimum heater tightness to be 
 maintained, it is recommended to adjust all clearance to minimum values, to 
 such however, that prevent the boards from wearing through rubbing by the 
 rotor rotation. The preset clearance of sector board ends and the axial boards 
 can be observed visually through the door on the axial sealing branch.

sections.text: Attention

items:
There is a danger of hot flue gas or air escape during such inspection, 
 therefor a face shield or a gas mask should be used and the hands should be 
 protected with gloves.

sections.text:
Instructions for 
clearance adjustment in hot state :

items:
The adjust of 
 clearance of sector and axial boards under full operation i.e. in hot state 
 of the regenerative air heater must be done so as to prevent the extraction 
 flow increase of the drive electric motor towards the value established under 
 cold run. However the clearance should be reduced to such value to secure the 
 combustion air leakage as low as possible and to secure full safety and 
 perfectness of the whole plant .

In case of 
 crack of the regenerative air heater - rotor deformation fire, etc. The 
 rotor dimensions may change due to uneven thermal extension to such measure 
 that it causes excessive friction between the rotor and sealing. It manifests 
 itself in excessive and unnatural sounds in the area of axial and sector 
 boards. In such cases the regenerative air heater should be shut down and 
 disconnected from the flue gas and air channels in closing the respective 
 valves, then the cause of the failure should be found out and removed.

Maintenance of blowing and washing device

Following maintenance should be done on the blowing and washing devices of the 
regenerative air heater, figure (4)

items:
Check regularly 
 if both the steam and water closing fittings are tight and if the jets of the 
 blowing and washings arms are not attacked by corrosion or clogged.

If you find out 
 that the fittings leak, repair or exchange them immediately, because the 
 leaking steam or water are sources of corrosion damaging the rotor heating 
 elements.

The dirty or 
 corroded jets must be cleaned , the damaged and worn ones exchanged.

Check the 
 terminal switches limiting the swings of the blowing arms.

Check the 
 tightness of the blower joints and of all their motion parts.

Check regularly 
 the oil state in blower gearboxes and if necessary, refill for exchange the 
 oil.

Check and 
 lubricate the motion screw bearings, the motion screw and the nut regularly, do that in harmony.

sections.text:
Fire 
extinguisher equipment

items:
Check the fire 
 extinguisher pipe and prevent any leakage if found.

Check the fire 
 extinguisher jet and clean it if clogged.

Repair any part 
 if needed.

Operate the 
 system manually and to tested it .

sections.text: Lubrication

In 
General

items:
It is necessary 
 to lubricate all rotating parts of the regenerative air heater. It works under 
 hot operating conditions, which requires special caution in selecting suitable 
 lubricants.

The 
 maintenance worker should be entrusted with regular lubrication, being 
 responsible for checking all lubrication spots. He should have a lubrication 
 chart at disposal with lubricating instructions for the regenerative air 
 heater.

The lubrication 
 chart should include the quality of the lubricants, time interval of the 
 checks and the lubricant exchange in harmony with the lubrication chart. If 
 the lubricant of required quality is not on store, it is necessary to settle 
 on a suitable substitute lubricant with the special technical service of the 
 supplier.

The lubricants 
 must be refilled and exchanged according to the lubrication charge may not be 
 admitted no more is desirable super charging the bearings with grease and 
 mixing various kinds or lubricants.

sections.text: Instructions for lubricant exchange

items:
Before the 
 first filling or the bearings or gearboxes with a lubricating charge / grease 
 or oil / all parts and surfaces being in contact with the lubricant must be 
 cleaned orderly having cleaned the surfaces, wash them with kerosene or with 
 special flushing oil.

Don't use 
 cloth or rage releasing fibers for cleaning the bearings and sliding surfaces, 
 during the bearing assembly observe the possibly highest cleanness leave the 
 bearings in the original packing till using them for the assembly.

Apply always 
 the lubricants of the same quality for the given lubricating spot ! if it is 
 necessary to apply some other lubricant quality to be settled with special 
 technical service of the lubricant supplier remove first all residues of 
 original lubricant , and wash the whole lubricating space orderly.

Following maintenance should be done on the blowing and washing devices of the 
regenerative air heater, figure (4)
Check regularly 
 if both the steam and water closing fittings are tight and if the jets of the 
 blowing and washings arms are not attacked by corrosion or clogged.
If you find out

Lubrication
In 
General
It is necessary 
 to lubricate all rotating parts of the regenerative air heater. It works under 
 hot operating conditions, which requires special caution in selecting suitable 
 lubricants.
The 
 maintenance worker should be entrusted with regular lubrication, being 
 responsible for checking all lubrication spots. He should have a lubrication 
 chart at disposal with lubricating instructions for the regenerative air 
 heater.
The lubrication 
 chart should include the quality of the lubricants, time interval of the 
 checks and the lubricant exchange in harmony with the lubrication chart. If 
 the lubricant of required quality is not on store, it is necessary to settle 
 on a suitable substitute lubricant with the special technical service of the 
 supplier.
The lubricants 
 must be refilled and exchanged according to the lubrication charge may not be 
 admitted no more is desirable super charging the bearings with grease and 
 mixing various kinds or lubricants.
Instructions for lubricant exchange
Before the 
 first filling or the bearings or gearboxes with a lubricating charge / grease 
 or oil / all parts and surfaces being in contact with the lubricant must be 
 cleaned orderly having cleaned the surfaces, wash them with kerosene or with 
 special flushing oil.
Don't use 
 cloth or rage releasing fibers for cleaning the bearings and sliding surfaces, 
 during the bearing assembly observe the possibly highest cleanness leave the 
 bearings in the original packing till using them for the assembly.
Apply always 
 the lubricants of the same quality for the given lubricating spot ! if it is 
 necessary to apply some other lubricant quality to be settled with special 
 technical service of the lubricant supplier remove first all residues of 
 original lubricant , and wash the whole lubricating space orderly.
